ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity values (black) with a macro-level ratio of approximately 95:5 dark-to-light pixels, where light pixels are localized to discrete anomalous clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) distribution across the total surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are mapped as small, isolated circular clusters (mottling) and dense contiguous aggregations on the extreme lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel-depth reaching approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire continuous boundary; characterized by non-uniform peak-to-valley amplitudes with distinct jaggedness on the inner curve of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral symmetrical S-curve trajectory; transitioning from a convex curve near the peduncle attachment to a concave curve approaching the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel rings (barnacle attachment sites) concentrated on the outer distal edges of both lobes; scattered individual circular high-contrast marks distributed across the central-left and central-right ventral planes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical-oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the central-left lobe area, breaking the uniform dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the extreme left and right tips, characterized by protruding 3D texture and high-contrast white pixel clusters; numerous circular white scars (likely post-colonization marks) scattered across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jaggedness of the trailing edge combined with extreme distal barnacle encrustation providing a unique perimeter profile.
